axes.label: Requirement Framing
axes.description: Quality of clarifying questions; did they scope the real ambiguity in stage 1?

axes.label: Architecture & Component Design
axes.description: Soundness and clarity of the proposed structure.

axes.label: Tradeoff Reasoning
axes.description: Explicit justification of choices against the assigned column constraint.

axes.label: Constraint Satisfaction
axes.description: Does the design actually hold up against the assigned constraint, not just mention it.

axes.label: Adaptability
axes.description: How well the design absorbs the stage-4 twist: patched vs re-architected vs collapsed.

axes.label: Design-Code Alignment
axes.description: Does the implementation match what was proposed in stage 2; flags drift/contradiction.

axes.label: Correctness & Edge Cases
axes.description: Does it work, including boundary/failure conditions.

axes.label: Security & Defensive Coding
axes.description: Input validation, secrets handling, authz checks. Up-weighted in Phase 2 when C4 is the assigned column.

axes.label: Testing & Observability
axes.description: Tests written, error handling, logging/instrumentation present.

axes.label: AI Collaboration Quality
axes.description: If AI tools were referenced or used: quality of prompting, critical evaluation of AI output, knowing when to override or verify — demonstrates AI-augmented engineering judgment rather than passive AI delegation.

dynamicReweighting.note: Phase 2, not MVP. When enabled, the code axis matching the session's assigned column constraint gets an up-weighted multiplier, since that's the skill the session was specifically designed to pressure-test.
